title: Lucky Numbers in a Matrix
summary: Given an m x n matrix of distinct numbers, identify and return all elements that are the minimum in their respective row and the maximum in their respective column.
statement: Given an m x n matrix of distinct numbers, identify and return all elements that are the minimum in their respective row and the maximum in their respective column.
constraints: A lucky number is minimum in its row and maximum in its column.
hints: Precompute each row minimum and column maximum.
Scan cells and emit those equal to both precomputed extrema.
The two equalities are exactly the lucky-number definition.
editorial: The two equalities are exactly the lucky-number definition.

tests.explanation: Fifteen is its row minimum and its column maximum.
Seven is the only row-minimum also maximal in its column.
